# Switch

An on or off setting that applies at once, with no submit.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** Account settings.

- **Use it when:** A setting that should take effect as soon as it is flipped.
- **Not when:** A choice that waits for a form (checkbox).

Instead:

- [Checkbox](./checkbox.md): Waits for the form.
- [Toggle](./toggle.md): A pressed button in a toolbar.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Space flips it. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a switch with a visible label; on and off are announced. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add switch
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

<p class="odv-brandname">Aster</p>

| Key | What it controls | Points to, aster-light | Points to, aster-dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `control/checked` | Fill of a checked checkbox or an on switch. | `color.action.primary.@` → `aster.theme.light.color.action.primary.@` → `color.teal.light.600` | `color.action.primary.@` → `aster.theme.dark.color.action.primary.@` → `color.teal.dark.700` |
| `control/track` | Track of an off switch. | `color.border.strong` → `aster.theme.light.color.border.strong` → `color.slate.light.500` | `color.border.strong` → `aster.theme.dark.color.border.strong` → `color.slate.dark.400` |
| `control/thumb` | Switch thumb and checkmark color. | `color.surface.default` → `aster.theme.light.color.surface.default` → `color.slate.light.0` | `color.surface.default` → `aster.theme.dark.color.surface.default` → `color.slate.dark.50` |
| `control/radius` | Checkbox corner radius. | `radius.badge` → `aster.theme.base.radius.badge` → `radius.4` | same |
